title: feat(console): a public form's thank-you panel shows the record field values its {{record.field_name}} tokens name

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao6dvKNTFV98GfggJtMngWxP)_

Fixes #28444

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx, content/docs/ui/forms.mdx

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：公开表单提交后的感谢面板，`title` / `message` 里的 `{{record.case_number}}` 这类占位符现在会替换成提交应答 `fields` 里的值（例如工单号 CASE-0042），不再把占位符原文显示给访客。
- 为什么改：#28005 裁决 B 的 UI 半边；规范（#28440）与服务端（#28479）都已合并，服务端已经在应答里返回这些值，但 Console 还没有填。
- 风险与回滚：只影响声明了占位符的公开表单感谢面板；没有占位符的面板逐字不变；应答缺值时显示为空，值一律按纯文本显示。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 的 `fillThankYouPanel` 与 `readThankYouAnswerFields`，以及提交 `switch` 里新的 `thank-you` 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.thankYouRecordFields-28444.test.tsx`，预期 9 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`:

- `readThankYouAnswerFields(answer)` reads `fields` off the public submit answer through `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/api`). An answer that is not that shape (the schema is strict) carries no fields.
- `fillThankYouPanel(panel, fields)` replaces each token in the panel's `title` and `message`. Which tokens a text holds is `thankYouRecordFieldNames` (`@objectstack/spec/ui`); each named field's token is then its literal `{{record.` + name + `}}` spelling, split out of the text with a plain string `split`. There is no regex in the Console for this token. A name with no value in the answer (or an `Object.prototype` key such as `constructor`) fills as empty. A filled value is never read for tokens again, and the page draws the result as a React text child, so a value is text, never markup.
- The submit `switch` gets its own `thank-you` arm: on the public route it stores the answer's fields, and the confirmation panel draws the filled text. The internal route's answer is `CreateDataResponse`, not this shape, so it is not read (see Acceptance notes).

`ui/packages/data-objectstack/**` is untouched: the public submit is a direct `apiFetch` in `FormPage.tsx` (`submitPublic`), which hands back the bare JSON body, so `fields` is not dropped anywhere on the way.

Docs (the card's Skills-docs rider): `content/docs/ui/forms.mdx` (section 8, after the `kind` table) and `content/docs/ui/public-data-collection.mdx` (after the `submitBehavior` paragraph) each gain one sentence and one example, and both say only an engine-generated field (`autonumber`) may be named.

Root changeset `.changeset/28444-thank-you-record-fields.md`: `@object-ui/console` minor (Metadata-protocol `semantic`).

## Tests

New `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.thankYouRecordFields-28444.test.tsx` (the real `FormPage` on `/f/:slug`, fetch stubbed):

- A message and a title with `{{record.case_number}}` show the answer's `CASE-0042`.
- An answer with no `fields` renders the token as empty, and no `{{` reaches the DOM.
- A value carrying an `img` tag and a `b` tag shows as literal text; no such element is created.
- An answer with a key beyond `id` and `fields` fails the strict schema and fills nothing.
- `fillThankYouPanel`: a value that itself spells another name's token is not filled again; `{{record.constructor}}` fills as empty; a panel with no token is returned as authored.
- `readThankYouAnswerFields`: reads `fields` off the public answer; reads none off a `CreateDataResponse` or `undefined`.

Ablation (one run, not kept): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the `fillThankYouPanel(...)` call in the render with the raw panel text. The rendered tests went 4 failed, 5 passed (all four render pins red; the five helper unit pins stay green, as they call the helper directly). Restored; blob back to the HEAD blob `a4ac3681`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Translated panel text (the card's rider), measured by reading the code, not live.** `GET /forms/:slug` serves the translated view's `config` (`translateMetadataDocument('view', …)` in `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`), so the Console reads the tokens of the translated text. The submit answer's `fields` is built from `thankYouRecordFieldNames(match.form?.submitBehavior)`, the base text. So a translation that names a field the base text names fills; a translation that names a field the base does not renders that token empty, never as the token text. Not widened.
- **Internal route.** An internal (`/forms/:name`) form that declares a `thank-you` panel with tokens renders them empty: its answer is `CreateDataResponse`, which `PublicFormSubmitResponseSchema` (strict) refuses, and the card scopes the fill to the public answer. Before this PR it showed the token text. Filling it from the internal answer's `record` would be a second source; left for a card if wanted.
- **Empty heading.** A `title` that is only a token with no value now renders an empty heading rather than the default "Thank you!" (the card: empty, never the token text).
- `submitRedirect.ts` keeps its own `RECORD_TOKEN_RE` for the `redirect` arm; it is unchanged here.
